The Hidden Currents of the World

Long before the Collapse, the structure of reality was threaded with invisible pathways of energy.

These pathways were known as Leylines.

Leylines carried the forces that allowed imagination, matter, and meaning to interact within the structure of Adam Kadmon. They connected distant regions of the world and allowed energy, knowledge, and possibility to flow between them.

In the age before the Collapse, these currents were stable and predictable.

Today, they are anything but.

The Fractured Network

When Adam Kadmon shattered, the network of leylines fractured along with it.

Some lines disappeared entirely.
Others became unstable or distorted.
Many were severed from the systems that once regulated their flow.

Despite this damage, fragments of the network still remain.

Across the world, explorers and scholars continue to discover places where the currents of energy still move beneath the surface of reality.

These surviving pathways shape many of the strange phenomena found across the hexes.

Where Leylines Appear

Leylines are rarely visible directly, but their presence can often be detected through the effects they produce.

Regions influenced by strong leyline currents may display signs such as:

• unusual magical activity
• strange environmental phenomena
• ancient infrastructure built along precise geometric patterns
• locations where artifacts or rituals behave unpredictably

In some places, the currents become strong enough to influence entire regions.

These locations are often considered sites of great power or great danger.

Ley Gates

In certain locations, the ancient builders of the world constructed structures designed to interact with leyline currents.

These structures are known as Ley Gates.

When functioning properly, a Ley Gate can channel the energy of the leylines to connect distant regions of the world.

This allows travelers to move between two locations far more quickly than normal travel would allow.

Most Ley Gates were damaged during the Collapse, but some remain partially functional.

Discovering and restoring these gates can dramatically change how factions move across the world.

Leylines and Magic

Magic is deeply connected to the flow of leyline energy.

In regions where leylines are strong, magical abilities and strange phenomena may become more powerful or more unpredictable.

Spellcasters, mystics, and scholars often study leyline currents to better understand how magic behaves in different regions of the world.

Some believe that mastering the flow of these energies could allow factions to stabilize entire regions of reality.

Leylines and the Great Work

Many who pursue the Great Work believe that repairing the network of leylines is essential to restoring the world.

If the broken connections between fragments of reality could be reestablished, the deeper systems that once held the world together might begin functioning again.

For this reason, many factions seek to locate and stabilize regions where leyline currents still flow.

Every restored connection strengthens the possibility that the fragments of reality might one day reconnect.

The Dangers of the Currents

Not all leyline phenomena are beneficial.

In places where the energy currents have become unstable, the results can be dangerous.

These unstable regions may produce:

• unpredictable magical surges
• distorted environments
• strange creatures drawn to the energy
• locations where reality behaves unpredictably

Because of this, explorers must approach strong leyline regions with caution.

Great power often comes with great risk.

In Simple Terms

Leylines are the hidden energy currents that once connected the world.

Although the Collapse fractured their network, fragments of these pathways still shape the strange forces found across the hexes.

Understanding and restoring these currents may be one of the keys to completing the Great Work.
